capabilities: Index metadata across all files including attachments, PDFs, and images
Run Dataview-compatible queries at section and block granularity
Edit values inside table views inline
Build React-based JavaScript views with internal state and flickerless updates
Embed pages, images, and videos in query views
extras: Documentation is hosted elsewhere and the plugin is explicitly a work in progress; no usage examples are included in the README.
intentEvidence: Datacore is a work-in-progress re-imagining of Dataview
motivation: The author wanted 2-10x better query and rendering performance than Dataview plus fully interactable views.
problem: Dataview-style queries render slowly and produce static results that cannot be edited or interacted with.

relations.evidence: Datacore is fundamentally the same thing as dataview - an index over Markdown files

summary: Reactive query engine that indexes Markdown file metadata and renders live-updating, editable table and task views.
